pages.text: Slay the $(4)Kraken$() and it finally gives up what everyone came for: $(item)Kraken Tentacles$(), each one wider than your boat used to be.

One tentacle on the $(item)Cutting Board$() slices into three $(item)Calamari Rings$(), with a fair chance of a bonus ink sac. The rings fry up beautifully — see the $(l:orespawn_delight:the_kitchen/sushi_bar)Sushi Bar$() and $(l:orespawn_delight:the_kitchen/the_cooking_pot)Ink-Black Pasta$().
